name: Talas Alatau
desc: The range walling the Talas valley on the south, highest at Manas Peak (4,482 m) at its western end.

name: Kyrgyz Range
desc: The long range between the Talas and Chu valleys, crossed by the Kök-Bel road.

name: Karatau
desc: Low limestone and shale range trending NW from the western end of the Talas Alatau.

name: Chatkal Range
desc: The range between the Chatkal valley and the Fergana basin.

name: Pskem Range
desc: The range between the Pskem and Chatkal valleys on the Uzbek side.

name: Ugam Range
desc: The range north of the Pskem along the Kazakh border.

name: Fergana Range
desc: The range closing the Fergana basin on the north-east, with the Babash-Ata spur behind Arslanbob.

name: Suusamyr Range
desc: The range on the south side of the Suusamyr valley.

name: At-Oinok Range
desc: The range between the Toktogul basin and the upper Naryn gorges.

name: Moiynkum Desert
desc: Sand desert between the lower Talas and the Chu.

name: Betpak-Dala
desc: The clay and stone desert north of the Chu.

name: Talas Valley
desc: The valley of the Talas between the Kyrgyz Range and the Talas Alatau, the heart of Irad.

name: Chatkal Valley
desc: The long trough of the Chatkal between the Talas Alatau and the Chatkal Range.

name: Suusamyr Valley
desc: High summer-pasture valley between the Kyrgyz and Suusamyr ranges.

name: Ketmen-Töbö Basin
desc: The basin of the Toktogul Reservoir.

name: Chu Valley
desc: The lower valley of the Chu, below the Kazakh-Kyrgyz reach.

name: Fergana Valley
desc: The great irrigated basin to the south, in Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan.
